info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Pharmacy Prescriptions Interactions-v1-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescriptions Interactions API enables consumers to retrieve detailed information about potential interactions between various pharmacy prescriptions. This API serves as a vital resource for healthcare providers and pharmacists, allowing them to ensure the safety and efficacy of prescribed medications. By querying this endpoint, users can access data that aids in assessing compatibility and identifying any risks associated with drug interactions. Typical use cases include supporting clinical decision-making and enhancing patient care through informed prescription management.

get.summary: Retrieve medication interaction information for prescriptions.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch detailed information about potential interactions between prescribed medications. It helps healthcare professionals ensure patient safety by identifying and addressing possible drug interactions before they occur.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve drug interaction information based on the provided prescription details. It should contain the relevant parameters for querying interactions related to the prescribed medications.

200.description: Request completed successfully; interactions data retrieved.
